Team —

Quick nudge: finance flagged a gap in our Q2 commit that traces back to a handful of long-running Nimbus Health opportunities with inconsistent stages and open close dates. I pulled a small lookup and attached the spreadsheet (q2-pipeline-stale-opps-lookup.xlsx) — please action the rows you own by EOD Thursday: either confirm a firm close date + stage (Commit/Best Case/Uncommitted) or tag as "deferred/archive" with a short reason.

What I need from you: 
- Update SFDC stage and close date on the rows you own (use reason codes when moving to deferred).
- If you plan to keep as Commit, add a 1‑line note in the Opportunity Comments summarizing the customer signal (PO coming, legal timeline, etc.).
- If you need finance/discount exceptions to keep as Commit, CC me and include the ask + expected ARR impact so I can escalate.

Nimbus Health (deal id NIM-1943) is the largest of the set — Laura, can you confirm the revised close date and whether procurement has signaled a firm PO? If procurement needs a final review, add the procurement contact to the HubSpot deal.

Attachments: [Attachment: q2-pipeline-stale-opps-lookup.xlsx (xlsx, 42KB)], [Attachment: nim_health_map.pdf (pdf, 85KB)]

Thanks — short and surgical here, I know people are heads-down.

— Evelyn
